language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon starts on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around it and lifts it clear of the table (frames 64–100, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it over the open drawer (frames 138–156, image and wrist_image). It releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 157–162; the spoon remains resting inside as the empty gripper withdraws through frame 194 (wrist_image, corroborated by image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
